The browser host imports Epoxy Transport from jsDelivr at runtime:
@mercuryworkshop/epoxy-transport 3.0.1

The browser host also imports libcurl Transport from jsDelivr when selected:
@mercuryworkshop/libcurl-transport 2.0.5 (AGPL-3.0-only)
https://github.com/MercuryWorkshop/CurlTransport
https://github.com/MercuryWorkshop/CurlTransport/blob/main/LICENSE
